questions.stem: All of the following can be done to transport a polytrauma patient who is conscious except?

options.label: A
options.text: Strap their thorax, abdomen and lower limbs on a stretcher

options.label: B
options.text: Place in prone position to prevent aspiration

options.label: C
options.text: Put patient on lateral position and shift him immediately

options.label: D
options.text: Roll the patient onto a hard board
